narration.text: In India, when a doctor says, arrange blood, families start calling blood banks. One by one.
Jeevan Dhara lets them simply ask. In their own language.
No forms. No language menu. It asks only for what is missing, and listens again.
Gnani's Prisma model turns speech into text, and detects the language by itself.
It becomes structured data, checked in code, so a blood group is never guessed. Then the search widens, ring by ring.
Gnani's Timbre voice answers, in the same language.
Kannada. Tamil. Ten languages. Speech to text in about a second. Search, in one millisecond.
Jeevan Dhara. Speak, and find blood. Built on Gnani Prisma and Timbre.

callers.text: ओ नेगेटिव, दो यूनिट, जयनगर बेंगलुरु में।
ನನಗೆ ಬಿ ಪಾಸಿಟಿವ್ ರಕ್ತ ಬೇಕು, ಎರಡು ಯೂನಿಟ್, ಕೋರಮಂಗಲ ಬೆಂಗಳೂರು.
எனக்கு ஏ பாசிட்டிவ் ரத்தம் வேண்டும், டி நகர் சென்னை.
